breakdown.description: Large pressure drops in gases cause significant density changes
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses a constant air density of 1.225 kg/m³ despite the 10 bar to 1 bar pressure drop. The ground truth requires density to be variable and calculated from the equation of state. The agent repeated the original error.

breakdown.description: Incompressible assumption is invalid for 10:1 pressure ratio
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the incompressible formula (Volume Flow Rate × constant Density) for a 10:1 pressure ratio. The ground truth requires compressible flow treatment with variable density (integrating ρ·u·dA). The agent repeated the original error.
